resumo_longo: TSE aprovou resolução para identificar canais digitais ligados oficialmente a campanhas eleitorais, exigindo comunicação à Justiça Eleitoral.Critérios incluem uso de recursos, funcionários, suporte técnico, divulgação oficial e coordenação de conteúdos em canais digitais.Canais espontâneos não têm vínculo automático; vínculo identificado implica cumprimento das regras de propaganda e responsabilidade legal. O Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) aprovou por unanimidade, nesta sexta-feira (16), uma resolução que estabelece critérios para identificar quando canais de WhatsApp e outros espaços digitais administrados por apoiadores devem ser considerados parte da estrutura oficial de campanhas eleitorais. A norma determina que canais enquadrados nessa condição sejam comunicados à Justiça Eleitoral e sigam as regras de propaganda aplicáveis às candidaturas. A decisão, relatada pelo ministro André Mendonça, foi aprovada pelos sete integrantes da Corte em plenário virtual e ocorre após a controvérsia envolvendo o canal “Exército do Lula”, ligado a apoiadores do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que disputa o segundo turno contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). No Kings has more than 3,000 events planned across the US. The planned events, this time dubbed “No Kings: Vote Early”, were billed as nonpartisan, though they sought to build on nearly two years’ worth of No Kings marches and demonstrations by people upset with Trump’s presidency. “It’s a day of nonpartisan voter participation: we are bringing our community together to make a plan to vote early and ensuring every eligible voter understands their options for how to vote and has the opportunity to make their voice heard,” organisers said in a statement. By advocating for voting early, the “No Kings” organisers hope to cut off the potential for any malfeasance once election day rolls around. A band entertained what appeared to be a few hundred people in caps and coats at the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, DC. resumo_longo: Hundreds of thousands of Europeans have taken to the streets in separate, uncoordinated demonstrations to protest against the rising cost of living in their countries. Saturday’s protests were in Belgium, France, Italy and Portugal in a wave of unrest that has put pressure on national governments across the European Union. France experienced one of its most turbulent days of protests in decades, with over 550,000 people joining demonstrations and police facing off with protesters across the country – but it was not the only country to see significant demonstrations. In Belgium’s capital Brussels – which has already seen weeks of protests by students against university registration fees – police fired tear gas and water cannon to disperse protesters, who they accused of launching missiles at them and setting fires. In Liege, a smaller city east of Brussels, police also deployed water cannon to break up demonstrations. Police did not say how many people attended. An estimated tens of thousands of protesters marched in Lisbon, the Portuguese capital, against the cost of living crisis, low wages and an inability to access housing in major cities. At least 1,200 people were arrested during what the French government described as an "escalation in violence" alongside an estimated 550,000 taking to the streets. In Paris, there were significant clashes into the evening with riot police, who used tear gas and water cannon on crowds. Buildings were set alight in the capital and other areas, including in Limoges where a large fire in the town hall caused the roof to partly collapse. Looting broke out in several cities, with widespread vandalism targeting city halls and businesses also reported. La Barrique bar in Paris was set on fire Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said 150 police officers were injured in the unrest. In Paris, the main march appeared to be largely peaceful during the afternoon. A group of young people told the BBC they were "pacifists" who are "just trying to make things change, but nothing is moving". The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) also condemned what they called "the severe act of violence" and said they were investigating. But the office of the Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu cast doubt on what happened and suggested it was part of a "coordinated campaign to smear Israel". The attack came only a day after a number of Palestinians and Heidi Levine, a Washington Post photographer, were injured in a separate assault by settlers in another village in the West Bank. The diplomats - from Belgium, France, Poland and the Catholic Church - had come to the largely Christian village of Taybeh near Ramallah. resumo_longo: Watch: The BBC reports from Tirana, where violent protests grew on Saturday Demonstrators and riot police fought pitched battles in the centre of Tirana on Saturday for the fifth day in a row. Masked protesters, many of them high school and university students, hurled rocks and petrol bombs at riot police trying to defend the education ministry, one of the focal points of the protests. The police responded with water cannon and volleys of tear gas, sending the crowds scattering. There are also reports that rubber bullets were used for the first time. Protests which began in the summer have grown into a wider anti-government movement, with calls for the prime minister to resign following corruption allegations linked to his administration. Many of the protesters in central Tirana wore gas masks or face masks, while volunteers handed out syringes of saline eyewash to reduce the pain from the tear gas which billows down the street. resumo_longo: LONDON, April 12 (Xinhua) -- Actions by the British government during the European Union referendum led to public mistrust, a committee of MPs said Wednesday in a parliamentary report. The House of Common's Public Administration and Constitutional Affairs Committee report said any future referendum in Britain should take note of the lessons learned from the way Brexit referendum was handled, including damage to the reputation of the civil service and the lack of preparation for either of the possible outcomes. The report said that while the then prime minister David Cameron's government did not support a Leave vote, they had a constitutional and public obligation to prepare for both outcomes from the referendum. "Unfortunately, many of the government's actions in the run-up to the referendum, which were easily avoidable, appear to have increased public distrust. The use of the machinery of government during the referendum contributed to a perception that the civil service were, in some way, biased," the report said in its conclusions. The court said in a statement that Park's major criminal allegations can be justified while concerns remain about a possibility of her destroying evidence. The arrest warrant, which was sought by prosecutors earlier this week, was issued by the court following the Thursday hearing that lasted for almost nine hours, the longest-ever in the country's history. Park became the third South Korean former leader to be taken into custody. Os números fazem parte do Projeto de Monitoramento do Desmatamento na Amazônia Legal por Satélite (Prodes), sistema responsável pelo cálculo oficial das taxas de desmatamento no país. resumo_longo: At least 17 people have been killed and many more injured in a crush at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark the Hindu festival of Durga Puja, officials say. The incident occurred during sudden rainfall, which witnesses say prompted a surge of people to try to seek shelter. West Bengal's Chief Minister Suvendhu Adhikari said a seven-year-old girl was among the dead, and that 25 people were being treated for injuries. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi described it as a "tragic" incident and said the regional government was providing help to affected families. Six of the dead have been identified, Adhikari said. A senior police official told the AFP news agency that an announcement caused "commotion" after it started raining and the crowd started "pushing, pulling and rushing forward and fell on the ground, leading to the stampede.". Deadly crowd incidents, including during religious festivals, are not uncommon in India due to poor management and lack of adequate safety precautions. resumo_longo: An 80m (263ft) luxury vessel has been repeatedly spotted in satellite images off North Korea's Wonsan coast from July to mid-October this year. What stands out is the 50m swimming pool along the deck, with a cluster of waterslides at one end. After sitting idle for months at a maintenance facility, it relocated in early July to waters off a strip of coastline known as the Kalma Peninsula. This is close to Wonsan, a seaside resort with a sprawling villa used by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and his family. It was not the only large vessel on the move. A handful of others were also repeatedly seen near Kim's villa, in satellite images analysed by the BBC. The vessels are widely believed to be used by Kim and his family. Former North Korean officials, defectors and experts say it would be difficult for anyone unconnected to the regime's leadership to own or freely use vessels of this size. "In winter, they would keep them at the shipyard. When summer came, they would bring them out and move them to Kim Jong Un's villa or towards Kalma, and use them for swimming and recreation," says Ri Jong Ho. Li Huifang, who operated the Heshi Peixin Kindergarten in Tianshui, in the Gansu province, was sentenced to life in prison for producing and selling toxic and harmful food, according to Chinese state media. In July 2025, 247 pupils and staff at the nursery were found to have abnormally high blood lead levels after children began falling ill. A report into the incident found that chefs at Heshi Peixin had used inedible paint to "enhance the look" of its meals to attract more students - despite the paint being being clearly marked as such. In addition to the sentence, the Lanzhou Intermediate People's Court also ordered the confiscation of 500,000 yuan (£56,200; $74,700) of Li's personal assets, state broadcaster CCTV reported. resumo_longo: O papa Leão XIV deixou o hospital Gemelli, em Roma, neste sábado 17, quatro dias após ser submetido a uma cirurgia para tratar um câncer de pulmão. Dezenas de pessoas saudaram o papa quando ele saiu do hospital e entrou em um veículo que o aguardava para retornar ao Vaticano. Seu médico pessoal e cirurgião afirmou, em um comunicado separado, que Leão foi considerado "apto para receber alta hospitalar" com base nos resultados de exames de sangue e em uma radiografia de tórax realizada na manhã deste sábado, além de uma avaliação de seu estado clínico. Leão, de 71 anos, teve o lobo inferior do pulmão direito removido depois que médicos identificaram um nódulo com suspeita de câncer. A cirurgia confirmou que ele tinha adenocarcinoma, o tipo mais comum de câncer de pulmão. Desde a cirurgia de terça-feira, que confirmou o diagnóstico de câncer, Leão tem dado fortes sinais de boa recuperação, incluindo a realização de um telefonema com o presidente russo Vladimir Putin, reuniões com assessores de alto escalão e a celebração de missa na capela do hospital. /AP...

titulo_es: Valter Pomar: “A nação petista vencerá”
texto_es: Em entrevista à TV 247, o historiador e dirigente do PT analisa a reta final da disputa presidencial e aponta o protagonismo da militância nas ruas
resumo_longo: Em entrevista à TV 247, o historiador e dirigente do PT analisa a reta final da disputa presidencial e aponta o protagonismo da militância nas ruas 247 – Às vésperas da definição do futuro político do país, o programa Trilhas da Democracia, transmitido pela TV 247, recebeu o professor de Relações Internacionais da UFABC e dirigente histórico do Partido dos Trabalhadores (PT), Valter Pomar. Com uma análise incisiva sobre o cenário eleitoral, Pomar reafirmou sua convicção na vitória de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva no segundo turno contra a candidatura da extrema-direita representada por Flávio Bolsonaro. Para o historiador, o motor principal da virada eleitoral não reside em acenos à classe dominante ou em alianças com setores do empresariado, mas sim na força do trabalho de base promovido pela militância progressista — aquilo que ele define carinhosamente como a “nação petista”. Durante a entrevista, Valter Pomar lembrou que, desde o final de 2024, previa uma disputa acirrada decidida no segundo turno por uma pequena margem de votos. Crítico das avaliações otimistas que previam uma vitória no primeiro turno, ele apontou que a esquerda brasileira ainda enfrenta o desafio de conscientiza...

resumo_longo: Governo estuda linhas de crédito e capacitação para empresas afetadas pelo fim da escala de trabalho 6×1. Ministro Durigan cita apoio à inovação e parcerias com Sebrae para modernizar processos e treinar trabalhadores. Mudança na jornada reduz para 40h semanais; governo avaliará impactos e oferecerá financiamento para adaptação. O governo federal estuda criar linhas de crédito e programas de capacitação para empresas que enfrentarem dificuldades com o fim da escala de trabalho 6×1. A medida foi anunciada nesta sexta-feira (16) pelo ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, que afirmou que o financiamento deverá apoiar a adaptação dos negócios à nova jornada, com investimentos em inovação e produtividade. “É possível que a gente faça, por exemplo, uma espécie de linha de crédito ou de capacitação para a inovação”, disse Durigan em entrevista à TV Band. Segundo o ministro, o governo pretende oferecer condições para que empresas reorganizem suas atividades e mantenham a produção diante das mudanças na jornada de trabalho. A polícia israelense abriu uma investigação sobre o ataque a uma delegação diplomática europeia na aldeia palestina de Taybeh, na Cisjordânia ocupada, neste sábado (17/10). Representantes da França, Bélgica e Polônia estavam entre os integrantes do grupo, que também incluía representantes católicos e um prefeito francês. Um veículo do consulado belga teve uma janela quebrada durante a ação. Notícias internacionais, com análise crítica e independente. Sem filtros. O ministro das Relações Exteriores da Bélgica, Maxime Prévot, afirmou que agressores mascarados atacaram a delegação e palestinos que participavam da colheita de azeitonas na região. Segundo ele, o prefeito francês Bernard Baudoux também foi agredido. Prévot informou que os integrantes da equipe diplomática belga estavam em segurança. “Condeno com a máxima firmeza o ataque perpetrado por colonos mascarados em Taybeh, na Cisjordânia ocupada, contra palestinos, nosso cônsul, diplomatas franceses e poloneses e representantes católicos”, declarou o ministro em publicação nas redes sociais.
